description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractUserRoleManager' within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing user roles, permissions, and access control functionalities. It includes methods for handling user roles, checking permissions, accessible entities, workflow actions, and data group permissions, serving as a base class for concrete implementations.

classes.name: AbstractUserRoleManager
classes.description: An abstract class providing a blueprint for managing user roles, permissions, and access controls within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user object and computes associated user roles.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user object.

methods.name: getUserRolesForAuthUser
methods.description: Returns the list of roles associated with the current user.

methods.name: userHasNonPredefinedRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has any roles that are not predefined.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve entities the user has access to, based on permissions and roles.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve IDs of entities accessible by the user.

methods.name: isEntityAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a specific entity is accessible to the user.

methods.name: areEntitiesAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if multiple entities are accessible.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Abstract method to get properties of accessible entities.

methods.name: getAccessibleModules
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve modules accessible to the user.

methods.name: isModuleAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a specific module is accessible.

methods.name: isScreenAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to verify if a screen in a module is accessible.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to get permissions for a specific screen.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve API permissions for a given API class.

methods.name: isFieldAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a field in a screen is accessible.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch employees associated with a particular role.

methods.name: computeUserRoles
methods.description: Abstract method to compute roles for a given user.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a specific workflow action is permitted for the user.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Abstract method to get workflow actions the user can perform.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Abstract method to get states where certain actions can be applied.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch data group permissions, merging permissions if needed.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a collection of data group permissions based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Abstract method to get default page for a module.

methods.name: getHomePage
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the home page URL or identifier.

methods.name: essRightsToOwnWorkflow
methods.description: Returns whether ESS rights are mapped to user workflow rights; defaults to true.
